CustomField.description: Emits the Adobe Sign signer-fillable VAT text tag ONLY when the account has no Sales Tax Number (via Customer_VAT_Number__c). When known, the document prints the value as plain text instead (Kam 2026-08-20) and no Adobe field is placed, so the signer-overwrite write-back path applies only to blank-VAT customers.
CustomField.label: Order Form VAT Tag
